overview: The ruling council of Sith Lords that administered the reconstituted Sith Empire from Dromund Kaas under the Sith Emperor's direction.
history: Dark Council governed galactic affairs during the Sith Empire. Detailed chronicles, succession rules, and institutional structure will be expanded in a future update.
significance: Dark Council shaped the political identity of its era and remains a reference point when historians compare later governments across the Star Wars timeline.
notableEvents: Dark Council established as a governing authority in galactic records
